snippet.title: Late Shift  - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2890610?utm_source=youtube

Experience found-footage horror through the eyes of a missing cinema employee. Navigate a looping cinema, find anomalies, uncover the truth, and break the loop. Make sure every room is checked... thoroughly, or risk becoming another missing employee.
